Hi Tom — good news.

I’ve applied a $1,000 promotional credit to your account and extended the trial window by two weeks (new expiry: 2025-05-28). I’ve attached the short promo terms for your records. You should see the credit reflected in the billing page within a few minutes.

To help you hit value quickly, here are three quick activation items:
- Run one small inference job with the sample dataset (we recommend seq_len 256 to mirror your pipeline).
- Enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts to reduce cost.
- See our onboarding playbook (attached) for prompt templates and batching suggestions.

If it’s helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute pairing session with our Solutions engineer to walk through integration and run an end-to-end test. Book a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/onboarding-20

I’ll check in next week to see how things look.

Best,
